rows.grounds: compound epithet: bhūta-bhāryā (consort of beings) + vidhi/vidheśa (lord/husband) + īśvarī (sovereign lady)

items.question: What familial and sovereign relationships to beings are attributed to this goddess?
premises: The goddess is identified as the granddaughter of beings.
The goddess is identified as the daughter of beings.
The goddess is identified as the sovereign lady of the lord of the consort of beings.
items.inference: This goddess encompasses multiple generational, filial, and supreme governing relationships with respect to beings.
uncertainties: The internal analysis of vidheśvarī within the final compound follows the legacy gloss but may admit alternative segmentation.
items.plain_english: She is the granddaughter of beings, the daughter of beings, and the sovereign lady of the lord of the consort of beings.
